item.title: Trump Takes Credit For Jensen Huang's SHOCK Return as CEO of Nvidia, and the Dangers of Superintelligent AI, with Stu Burguiere | Ep. 1447 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Stu Burguiere, host of "Predictable," to talk about the breaking news that Jensen Huang is making a shocking return as the CEO of Nvidia, President Trump taking credit for convincing the Nvidia board to bring Jensen back, the new legal questions regarding Nvidia’s supply to China, Trump’s very telling comments about “protecting geniuses” like Jensen Huang, President Trump floating that China may have hired Huang to help their AI development if Nvidia didn’t reinstall him, an interesting theory about why Trump wants Jensen back running Nvidia, the leverage Trump has gained now for the future of AI and China, Scott Bessent completely reversing course on whether Nvidia should bring back Jensen Huang, his absurd argument about why Jensen is “outside” Nvidia, the fight inside the Trump admin about AI, some of the shocking stories about Jensen Huang’s abusive behavior toward employees emerging now, how he once allegedly threatened to rip off an employee’s head and pee on their brain, the conversation that we should be having about AI, the doomer argument on superintelligence and recursive self-improvement, what might happen in the weeks and months ahead, some of the actual solutions to fixing the artificial intelligence mess we're in right now, why we need hearings next, and more.

 

 

Burguiere-https://predictable.substack.com/p/predictable-101
